evidence_level.justification: The study is a preregistered, single-execution numerical confirmation: for each of the 15 HEMP-like designs of the accepted L1a geometry sweep v3 (the sealed catalogue's Sobol entries with Koch rho_conservative >= 1.5 at every wall cusp), the material-aware field is solved with the adaptive quadratic finite-element magnetostatic reference of the modern workstream (soft-iron poles mu_r 4000 in the inter-magnet gaps, a soft-iron return yoke, recoil-remanence SmCo-like magnets at mu_r 1.05; linear isotropic materials; two nested Dorfler/red levels at relative true residual 2e-10; CPU only, one design at a time, GPU untouched), sampled into the cusp topology search v3.1 definition on the sealed L1a axis window, post-scaled by the design's L1a magnet-strength scale, and compared with the sealed L1a record: wall-cusp count (strict and boundary-tolerant), sorted nearest-neighbour cusp matching within max(r_w / 8, L1a dz), wall |B| and Koch-rho ratios, channel and outside axis nulls, separatrix lean, level-0 vs level-1 discretisation and 1x vs 2x sampling stability. Its recorded outcome is the verdict CONFIRMED (gate (b) 15/15 cusp counts unchanged; gate (c) 37/37 matched cusps within tolerance, every matching a bijection, largest shift 0.80 of tolerance) with the reported HEMP-like preservation 14/15. The framework admits accepted numerical evidence through a typed committed manifest, hashed artifacts at a resolvable revision, exact registered claim text and generated artifacts with provenance sidecars; that pattern is applied here through the numerical-screening gate GATE-L1B-HEMP-CONFIRMATION-V1-1 at the new recorded outcome accepted-material-aware-confirmation. The field is the two-level screening configuration of the finite-element reference and not its three-level P2-qualified chain; the materials are linear; every ratio is a ratio of two field models and never a probability; nothing here is a saturation, plasma, mirror-probability, thrust, efficiency or design-recommendation claim. It is not the L1 field-resolved reduction of GATE-L1 (no manufactured solution, no L0 mapping, no performance model, no geometry response), not L2 and not L3, and it opens none of those gates. The predecessor campaign's development rejection (v1: 2/15 level-0 meshes below the inherited 10 deg angle gate) is bound as lineage and disclosed.

recorded_outcome_justification: The five earlier numerical-screening outcomes name studies on L1a linear-vacuum equivalent-current fields (a field-only screening, a null, a characterization, a test-particle dataset, and the literature cusp definition on those fields plus one P2-qualified row). This study is a different object: the same literature cusp definition applied verbatim to the material-aware P2 field (adaptive quadratic finite elements with LINEAR soft-iron poles and yoke and recoil-remanence magnets, two nested levels) of fifteen designs already screened on L1a fields, compared with their sealed L1a records under predeclared count and position tolerances, and classified by a preregistered verdict rule as CONFIRMED / PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED / DISCONFIRMED. Reusing accepted-topology-screening would state that the fields are L1a fields with one P2 row, which is false here, so a sixth outcome value, accepted-material-aware-confirmation, is added and the kind's description is amended to name it. Its meaning is the same as every other outcome: the study is admitted exactly as recorded (verdict CONFIRMED under the frozen tolerance rule; the sealed status is accepted_l1b_confirmation_confirmed), never as a positive finding about the thruster. What is confirmed is a property of two field models (the L1a separatrix-cusp count and wall-cusp positions survive the linear-iron field within one level-0 bore element), not saturation, plasma, mirror probability, thrust, efficiency or a design recommendation, and the field is not the three-level P2-qualified chain.
